cases.title: Blind fire projection submission
cases.expected_player_predecision: Shows submitted runes, topology, syntax-valid state and pending status but no interpreted cone-of-fire effect summary or predicted damage.
cases.expected_gm: Receives decoded FIRE projection, cone geometry, targets, owning-rule costs, SCI/CSL, warnings, counterplay and predicted mutations.
cases.acceptance: Player cannot obtain the resolved effect from preview, tooltip, notification, history, export, diagnostic or AI surfaces before GM adjudication.

cases.title: Blind healing construction
cases.expected_player_predecision: No healing amount, condition removal or restoration outcome is decoded for the player.
cases.expected_gm: Authorized GM sees restoration interpretation and owning healing/resource rules.
cases.acceptance: Approved result is atomically committed and only post-resolution reveal-policy information returns to the player.

cases.title: Blind mind influence with resistance
cases.expected_player_predecision: Player sees the submitted construction and target if target visibility permits, but not target resistance, secret difficulty or predicted control outcome.
cases.expected_gm: GM sees permitted resistance/counterplay evidence and the interpreted influence intent.
cases.acceptance: Blind play never bypasses resistance, permission, target-validity or setting-local mental-control rules.

cases.title: GM denial commits nothing
cases.expected_gm: GM sees summon source/reference validity and full interpreted effect.
cases.acceptance: Denial is attributable, silence is not approval, and no accepted summon, Effect, Condition or resource mutation is committed except separately governed pre-authorized attempt costs if such a rule exists.

cases.title: Modify-and-approve preserves original
cases.expected_player_predecision: No predicted field effect or damage is exposed.
cases.expected_gm: GM may reduce extent/duration or otherwise alter allowed resolved fields while preserving the original construction.
cases.acceptance: Original expression, original resolved proposal, changed paths, original/final values, reasons and decider identity are all retained; no silent rewrite is attributed to the player.

cases.title: Expression rewrite is explicit GM modification
cases.expected_player_predecision: Player sees submitted teleport construction without resolved legality or final destination effect.
cases.expected_gm: GM may only change the expression by recording a semantic modification with original and final expressions.
cases.acceptance: Changed rune syntax is never silently substituted and history distinguishes player-submitted from GM-adjusted construction.

cases.title: Hidden target state cannot leak
cases.expected_player_predecision: No hidden ward existence, secret modifier, protected count or compatibility clue is disclosed.
cases.expected_gm: Authorized GM projection may show hidden magical state necessary for adjudication.
cases.acceptance: Permission filtering precedes player serialization, counts, errors, AI context and post-resolution history.

cases.title: Invalid grammar stops before effect interpretation
cases.expected_player_predecision: Player receives a non-semantic explicit-grouping parser error.
cases.expected_gm: No pending GM proposal is created.
cases.acceptance: Invalid mixed-precedence syntax cannot be submitted and the error does not decode what the construction would have done.

cases.title: Unresolved required resource adapter
cases.expected_player_predecision: Player may be told submission cannot proceed because an allowed player-visible requirement is unresolved, but receives no hidden effect decode.
cases.expected_gm: If submission is permitted by owning rules, GM sees unresolved adapter details; otherwise no proposal is created.
cases.acceptance: No universal mana/default resource value is invented to make blind play proceed.

cases.title: Stale target before GM decision
cases.expected_gm: Final review detects changed target/session version and marks proposal stale or recovery-required.
cases.acceptance: The system never silently recalculates changed authoritative inputs and accepts them as the original proposal.

cases.title: Ambiguous submit response recovery
cases.expected_player_predecision: Client loses submit response and queries proposal status with the same operationId.
cases.expected_gm: At most one queue item exists.
cases.acceptance: Retry cannot duplicate proposal creation, item inscription, resource use or notifications.

cases.title: Ambiguous GM decision recovery
cases.expected_player_predecision: Player remains pending until authoritative status is recovered.
cases.expected_gm: Lost approve response is recovered with original decisionId/operationId before retry.
cases.acceptance: Exactly one final decision and one atomic commit may win.

cases.title: Player AI cannot defeat blind play
cases.expected_player_predecision: Player AI may describe syntax and accessibility mechanics but may not decode or predict the hidden magical result or GM approval.
cases.expected_gm: GM-side advisory AI may inspect only authorized GM projection and has no decision authority.
cases.acceptance: AI is incapable by contract of becoming a hidden-effect side channel or approval authority.

cases.title: Screen-reader blind rune construction
cases.expected_player_predecision: A screen-reader user can construct, group, serialize, validate and submit through semantic ordered controls without receiving hidden interpreted effect text.
cases.expected_gm: GM effect card has an ordered text/table equivalent to any visual graph.
cases.acceptance: Game-mechanic blindness never requires visual interaction and accessibility never leaks suppressed effect semantics.

cases.title: Offline blind draft
cases.expected_player_predecision: Offline player may edit the local construction but cannot obtain server effect resolution or submit it.
cases.expected_gm: No GM notification exists until reconnect, reauthorization and successful submission.
cases.acceptance: Offline mode cannot resolve hidden effects, create pending decisions, spend resources or mutate Session state.

cases.title: Post-resolution discovery remains policy-controlled
cases.expected_gm: GM approves an interpreted growth effect.
cases.acceptance: After commit the player receives outcome-only, observed-details or full-after-resolution information according to current Campaign/Session reveal and perception policy; success does not automatically teach every hidden rune mechanic.
